title: Board readiness: operational scenarios and contingency lanes for upcoming QBR
creator: Ravi Kapoor
description: Prepare a concise operational scenarios and contingency playbook to support the upcoming QBR and board readout. This ticket scopes the artifacts and asks needed to surface runway projections, three prioritized mitigation lanes (capacity, model-fallback, and cost-controls), and two escalation templates for customer-impact incidents. Deliverables: 1) 1-page executive scenario matrix (best / base / stress) with metrics impact; 2) a contingencies one-pager per lane (technical owner, rollback trigger, communication template); 3) a short ops runbook to be included in the board packet. The goal is to give execs a clear decision point for resource allocation and an actionable escalation path if the platform hits SLO stress under projected growth scenarios.
acceptance_criteria: Executive scenario matrix completed and validated by Eng/Infra, describing latency/cost/SLO delta for best/base/stress
Three contingency lane one-pagers reviewed and signed off by owners (Servicing Runtime, Routing, Finance)
Ops runbook with clear rollback/rollback-conditions, owners, and timeline included in the board packet
Board packet excerpt (1 page) prepared and linked in drive; ready for PM/CEO pre-read by 2026-03-16
notes: This ticket complements the QBR financial slides: we will attach a sensitivity table showing cost per 1k active sessions under quantization and caching changes.

We will present two recommended asks: a 3-month burst fund for Dedicated capacity and a cross-functional play to enable automatic model-fallback to smaller quantized variants under tail-latency events.
Target audience: CEO, Head of Eng, CFO, Board members for infrastructure-heavy customers. Keep language concise and action-oriented.
